title: Mix urlSync default strategy with anchor strategy
body:
Hey,

I would like to use both url parameters mapping strategies at the same time.
`s` => used as the query, provided like `/?s=myquery`
And all the others in the hash.

What is the best way to achieve that?

comments.body: Thanks for the question @rayrutjes. The current system is not pluggable so there is no way to do that. What kind of API would you see for that purpose?
This should be solved with https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/2636 and #2216  (just a PoC for now)
